item.title: Software Stocks Fall in Asia After US Tech Selloff: Markets Wrap
item.description: Software stocks slid from India to Japan, following declines in their US peers, on concern advances in artificial intelligence will undermine traditional business models.

item.title: Richest Indonesian Man’s Firms Plan Buybacks After Market Rout
item.description: Companies linked to Indonesian billionaire Prajogo Pangestu said they would buy back shares, in a bid to shore up prices after last week’s market meltdown.

item.title: Australia Weighs Minerals Price Floor to Lure Overseas Funds
item.description: Australia is weighing a price floor for critical minerals including rare earths, a move that sent local producers’ shares higher, as it seeks to counter China’s dominance and lure foreign investment into new mines and processing projects.

item.title: Abu Dhabi Oil Giant Plans Up to $2 Billion of Dim Sum Bonds
item.description: Abu Dhabi National Oil Co., the United Arab Emirates’ biggest oil producer, is planning to offer its first-ever yuan bond, the latest sign of deepening financial ties between China and the Gulf.

item.title: India Made Long Push With Trump Behind Scenes to Clinch US Deal
item.description: In early September, shortly after Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi held a chummy meeting with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping in China, he dispatched his national security adviser to Washington to help smooth over fraying ties.

item.title: Merz Seeks LNG Deals in Gulf Region to Hedge US Energy Exposure
item.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has set his sights on the Middle East to try and diversify energy supplies for Europe’s biggest economy and reduce dependency on LNG imports from the US.

item.title: AllianzGI, NEC Capital Join EdgePoint’s $475 Million Loan
item.description: Southeast Asia telecom tower operator EdgePoint Infrastructure has secured a $475 million syndicated loan from a mix of institutional investors and traditional banks, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Equinor Reduces Share Buyback as Quarterly Earnings Tumble
item.description: Equinor ASA reined in its share buyback after fourth-quarter profit missed analyst estimates amid a drop in oil and gas prices.
